title: a person who … · a thing that/which … (относительные придаточные предложения 1)

exercises.instruction: Используя слова и фразы из обеих рамок, напишите предложения по образцу: A … is a person who …. Если необходимо, воспользуйтесь словарём.

items.prompt: A thief
answers: A thief is a person who steals things.

items.prompt: A butcher is a person
answers: A butcher is a person who sells meat.

items.prompt: A musician
answers: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument.
A patient is a person who is ill in hospital.
A dentist is a person who takes care of your teeth.
A fool is a person who does stupid things.
A genius is a person who is very intelligent.
A liar is a person who doesn’t tell the truth.

exercises.instruction: Составьте одно предложение из двух предложений в скобках.

items.prompt: (A man phoned. He didn’t give his name.)
answers: The man who phoned didn’t give his name.

items.prompt: (A woman opened the door. She was wearing a yellow dress.)
answers: The woman who opened the door was wearing a yellow dress.

items.prompt: (Some students took the exam. Most of them passed.)
answers: Most of the students who took the exam passed (it).
Most of the students who took the exam passed.

items.prompt: (A policeman stopped our car. He wasn’t very friendly.)
answers: The policeman who stopped our car wasn’t very friendly.

answers: The people who live next door are very noisy.
